# Running the third-party checkers in containers

The comparisons in [docs/07 §7.8](../../docs/07-trial-results.md) run import-linter and dependency-cruiser only inside
these containers, with the repository under test mounted read-only.

```sh
docker build -t ucn-il trials/containers/import-linter
docker build -t ucn-dc trials/containers/dependency-cruiser

# import-linter: the project's own contracts, or a config generated by tools/ucn_export.py
docker run --rm -v "$REPO:/repo:ro" ucn-il --no-cache
docker run --rm -v "$REPO:/repo:ro" -v "$CFGDIR:/cfg:ro" ucn-il --no-cache --config /cfg/generated.importlinter

# dependency-cruiser: a generated config, JSON output (which tools/ucn_validate.py can read with --deps)
docker run --rm -v "$REPO:/repo:ro" -v "$CFGDIR:/cfg:ro" ucn-dc packages --config /cfg/generated.dependency-cruiser.js \
  --ts-config tsconfig.json --output-type json > depcruise.json
```

On Windows with Git Bash, set `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1` so volume paths are not rewritten.
